note: Rhythm/structure rules JSON Schema cannot express. Ids and severities are machine-checked against schema/semantic_validate.py RULES by verify_all.py (GRAPH_SYNC).

rules.rule: Exactly one HERO node per page; the not-found template has none (NO_HERO_TEMPLATES in the validator), every other template opens with one.
The first node that is not SHELL/UTILITY is the HERO (not-found excepted).
Sections with constraints.mustBeLast (overlay.partner-credits, mounted inside the footer) are the last node.
onePerPage / maxPerPage sections do not exceed their caps.
constraints.requires: the overlay needs the footer that mounts it.
constraints.templates restricts a section to its template family.
route matches the template's routePattern, in both modes.
A reference spec's route is mapped to its template in routes.json (the catch-all 404 may use any unmatched path).
Only SHELL/UTILITY sections may be retrievalEligible:false; nodes cannot override the contract.
editorial.blog-card-grid layout 'related' appears only on blog-post (2 cards); 'staggered' on every other template.
work.card-cluster seeAll is allowed only on the last cluster of a home page and never on /work clusters.
Two adjacent nodes of the same category, except the named exceptions.

exceptions.why: navbar and footer are never adjacent in practice; listed for symmetry
work card clusters repeat; case-study overview precedes showcase rows
case-study showcase media and image/text rows interleave
case-study showcase media and image/text rows interleave
two full-width showcases may follow each other
article chapters and blog card clusters repeat
awards, press, clients and testimonials are consecutive on the home page
about page lists follow each other
the overlay is mounted inside the footer
the overlay is mounted inside the footer

rules.rule: The same section twice in a row, except repeatable clusters, chapters and showcase rows.
A blog-post body with more than one chapter should give every chapter after the first a heading.
At most 2 ambient-loop motion nodes per page.
